status: bounded next-interface design; NOT a complete implemented authorization proof
decision: A verified owner-free whole-function emission result is conceptually sound and can eliminate current-MF reconstruction. The existing body tape is insufficient. A new explicit LLVM scalar-function renderer and effect protocol is required; do not reuse old AP helpers with MF=null.
producer: Run unchanged complete O2 and machine pipeline for the cold function. At the final post-provider AP boundary run actual MachineFunction::verify successfully; today cold typed capture alone does not supply this certificate.
Capture exact original MC lowering plus function/block/CFI decisions and all admitted emitter effects into one bounded owned product. No old LLVM/MC pointers escape.

Publish a private verified capability only after all admitted original emission, full observed pipeline tail, and whole object request succeed. Bind exact initial input/world/config/canonical pipeline, fixed SDK capability, complete product and typed/frame witness. Hash is only negative filtering; private immutable construction and full value keys remain authority.
consumer_state_machine: Fresh current module initialization and full original IR/O2 remain. At first machine callback preflight key, complete current pipeline and all capabilities before output or number reservation. Unknown: old typed/fresh path.

Proposed MMI reserveFunctionNumberForEmission(F): require no current MF for F, consume exactly the NextFnNum that getOrCreateMachineFunction would consume. Store one reservation in request-local state, not global learned state. Never reuse the old producer ordinal.

Skip matching machine computations only under the verified product. New no-MF gate must reject every unhandled non-MFP consumer in the whole current suffix. FreeMachineFunction after AP is permitted: erase of absent MF is a no-op and clears LastRequest/LastResult. No pass can demand a nonexistent MF implicitly.

At the original AP slot, invoke proposed emitVerifiedScalarFunction(current F, current per-function STI, current reserved number, descriptor, owned MC/CFI operations). Maintain original function ordering.
Run original current module finalization and MC assembler/layout/relaxation/encoding. Dirty failure discards the entire attempt; no in-stream fallback.

required_shared_interfaces.detail: No retained MMI owner or class-layout extension is inherently needed: expose a checked same-place NextFnNum reservation and keep per-function reservation in the request. Must be paired with no-MF suffix consumer gate.

Extract current-symbol/linkage/visibility/type, section, minimum/preferred alignment, function begin/end/ELF-size operations into helpers shared by original MF path and descriptor path. Explicit current STI is mandatory: getSubtargetInfo asserts MF; emitAlignment otherwise selects TM default STI. Function prefix/prologue/sanitize/patchable/GC/debug/metadata/sections extras remain unsupported unless included explicitly.

required_shared_interfaces.interface: Owned block decisions and ordered symbol roles
required_shared_interfaces.detail: Capture block number, force-label bit, alignment/maxskip, and result of original shouldEmitLabelForBasicBlock. Create BB roles lazily in original encounter order via current MCContext.createBlockSymbol(BB+currentFunctionNumber+blockNumber,forceLabel). Preserve current layout phase, not old byte offsets or old labels.

Factor ordinary begin/end frame so both original MF callbacks and descriptor use the same live handler.hasEmittedCFISections state and current ModuleCFISection. No personality list effects in this domain. markFunctionEnd is empty. The value-only emitCFIInstruction(MCCFIInstruction) already touches only current streamer. Producer must certify original MI-level trailing-CFI inclusion predicate; raw CFI table index is insufficient.

required_shared_interfaces.interface: X86 scalar emitter state with explicit STI
required_shared_interfaces.detail: Share current per-function subtarget/code emitter and shadow-state operations. Do not call old EmitAndCount through a null MF (getSubtargetInfo). Preserve start/end state, or gate genuinely inactive zero-shadow state using a source-proved predicate. Full-function path must explicitly handle or decline SLS block-end INT3; body tape correctly retains fresh blockEnd.

Current InstructionCount diagnostic construction requires an MBB/MF; no-MF path cannot silently omit it. Add a function-based diagnostic path with the same supported consumer behavior, or exact-decline all contexts where it is observable. Hotness/custom diagnostics remain unproved here.

keep_fresh: stack/fault map serializers and current MC finish
admitted_function_delta: HasNoSplitStack OR=true for no-split-stack admitted functions
EmittedInsts plus exact source instruction count
current symbol attributes/definition/size and current section/labels
Dwarf frame start/value operations/end through live shared handler
reject_or_prove: split-stack, GC, stack/fault maps, personality/LSDA/EH, XRay, patchable instrumentation, BB sections/address maps, debug/verbose, blockaddress, global/CPI/JTI/symbol operands, unknown AP hooks, SLS unless explicitly represented

nearest_counterexamples: Using old function ordinal after an earlier function was inserted changes all BB symbol roles.
Cold producer was not first unwind function but warm consumer is: caching hasEmittedCFISections decision loses required current .cfi_sections behavior.
Terminal CFI with no following real instruction must not be emitted outside the FDE range.
Using TM default STI after dropping MF can change function-specific alignment NOPs or instruction encoding.
A no-call return under harden-SLS-ret still emits INT3 at block end.
InstructionCount remarks and custom diagnostics can be observable even though MC bytes are equal.
Calling a non-MFP consumer that obtains MMI.getOrCreateMachineFunction after the skip decision silently creates an empty MF and consumes another function ordinal.
budget: Owned descriptor/MC/CFI/witness allocations use explicit exact capacity charge and existing product/history limits. No retained LLVMContext/Module/TM/MMI/MC owners. Initial implementation retaining full typed witness does not remove cold typed capture; a later separate VerifiedEmissionProduct contract could remove that redundant witness only when no MIR replay consumer remains.
limits: Private profile15 emit 56ms is the entire machine pipeline scope, not AP time. Restore about15ms and validate about8ms are children, not additive to56. Body tape saves only a subset; no-MF product can target those children but cannot remove current assembler/layout or 161ms O2. Cold extra MF.verify and descriptor capture may cost more. No measured speedup or complete O2 incrementality is claimed.
unclosed: Shared scalar renderer and all side-effect guards are not implemented or reviewed as a complete component.
Current actual full suffix must prove no unhandled non-MFP or hidden provider consumer; the body-only readonly two-ID window does not automatically authorize no-MF skipping.
X86 shadow/SLS and full function boundary symbol/effect protocol on mixed fresh/reused functions.
